title: How far the shows went: TOBA time, Omaha, Chicago, carnival dates
summary: The Rabbit Foot was strictly southern; Chicago shows played theaters on TOBA time as far as New York and Omaha; carnival stays lasted six days.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: The Rabbit Foot was strictly a southern show. Strictly southern show.
You mentioned one of the first things you went out about.
Michigan and all, did you ever get through New York or California that far away in any of those shows?

Well, yes, I got to New York with, I would say, Dash and Diana show. It's out of Chicago. And also Miss Broadway show. They're out of Chicago. But these show, these particular shows I'm speaking of now, was Waterville. It's played in the theaters. Well, I did go up there with those. Was that the old TO or the TOBA or something? TOBA time. That's what we was on. You were on that? TOBA time. Yep. That's the time. We played all those different theaters. Yep. Heard a lot about it. TOBA time. Well, most every different show I got on at that time, it doesn't make any difference what show it was. It still was on TOBA time. Yeah. Yeah. Sometime I would quit one show and join the next show and play the same territories over and over. Then I joined the next show and go over the same territories. TOBA time. Yep.
How far west did any of those shows get? Usually did they go as far as Kansas City or Omaha or any farther? Well, Omaha, Nebraska.
That's about far as some of them would get, Omaha, Nebraska. Then they start working right on back, all the way down the same way they went. Right back down in the south.
Did you ever get as far as Denver though or California at all? Denver?
Um, no. I didn't get far as Denver. We didn't go that way. I went far as Chicago with some of these carnival shows. I went to Chicago with, I mean, I remember finding brothers carnival.
How long, well I think of it, these questions I have to ask, well I think of it, how long do carnival play, play in one place, how long do they stay?

At a carnival show, I would say playing still dates. What you call still dates, that mean not playing a fair. Yeah. Not playing no fair at all. Yeah. That's still dates. Still dates is six days. Six days. That's for carnival show. And then after he's playing a fair, well he supposed to stay in a time, I would say, from two to three weeks. Really? That long? Sure. He'd stay that long. Two to three weeks, that's playing a fair. Other than playing a fair, a carnival show, always six days.
